help_ceramic_one: In most cases, the tiles do not need to be removed. MyPerol systems can be applied directly over firmly bonded tiles after thorough surface preparation, reducing installation time, waste and overall project costs.
help_ceramic_two: Removing the existing flooring is only recommended where there are structural issues, loose tiles, moisture problems or a substrate that cannot ensure proper adhesion of the system.

service_home_technical:
MP System HOME is a seamless flooring system designed for homes, villas and residential projects where aesthetics must meet the demands of everyday life. The system is specified to suit the substrate, surface condition and chosen finish, combining mechanical preparation, a high-adhesion primer, resin layers and a protective topcoat.

The result is a uniform surface without conventional visible joints, resistant to everyday wear and easy to maintain. Available in smooth, mineral or decorative finishes, it allows the flooring to complement the architecture, lighting and interior design of the space.
service_garage_technical:
MP System GARAGE is developed to withstand vehicle loads, frequent traffic, abrasion and the demands of an intensively used garage. Its multilayer build-up combines mechanical substrate preparation, an epoxy primer, reinforcement with selected aggregates, a resin layer and a protective finish suited to the level of use.

Smooth, decorative or slip-resistant finishes provide a durable, seamless surface that is easy to clean. Each system is adapted to sunlight exposure, the presence of oils, gradients, drainage and moisture conditions in the substrate.
service_business_technical:
MP System BUSINESS is designed for commercial spaces where flooring forms part of the customer experience. Clinics, shops, restaurants, offices, gyms and showrooms need surfaces that withstand daily foot traffic while maintaining a cohesive aesthetic.

The system combines a professionally prepared substrate, high-performance seamless layers and a protective topcoat selected to suit usage, cleaning routines and the required slip resistance. Colour, texture and gloss level can be customised to complement the business’s visual identity and support efficient maintenance.
service_industry_technical:
MP System INDUSTRY is developed for environments subject to loads, abrasion, industrial traffic and frequent cleaning. Each solution is designed around the actual demands of the operation: machinery type, intensity of use, chemical exposure, temperature, safety and the time available for installation.

Depending on the project, it can be specified as a multilayer, self-levelling or aggregate-reinforced system. Its structure delivers adhesion, mechanical strength and a texture suited to the workplace, creating reliable flooring that is straightforward to maintain and built for long-term professional use.
service_outdoor_technical:
MP System OUTDOOR is designed for terraces, entrances, porches and exposed areas where flooring must cope with temperature changes, sunlight, water and outdoor traffic. It is not a one-size-fits-all solution: each surface is assessed according to its substrate, exposure, gradients, joints and drainage system.

The specification may include bonding layers, levelling, coatings suitable for outdoor use and UV-resistant finishes. The surface texture is adapted to the intended use to enhance safety while ensuring the flooring remains in harmony with the architecture.
